messages.subject: Shiny server / ggplot2 error?
parts:
Hi folks -

I'm trying to get a Shiny server up and running on a CentOS machine and ... I'm almost there.  I'm getting an odd error when I try to serve up my app.
Wondering if it is related to a wrong version of something. 

I'm running R 3.0.1 on the server machine (as well as my Windows development machine, where my app works locally) and when Shiny server runs
(data is loaded via csv file) the app displays a plot using ggplot2.  But I get the following error, instead of a plot:

"error: unable to start device PNG"

Any idea what that's about?  Thanks.

  sudo yum install pango-devel

  make distclean
  ./configure
  make
